title: Interface Specification: the balancing state-machine interface

standards_mappings.rationale: Backs SWE.2 with a real interface specification: providing and consuming module, the real C signature transcribed from the header at 308028fb, per-parameter direction, unit, meaning and valid range with the mechanism that enforces it, a return contract whose values are the enumerators the source defines, validity signalling read off the real error paths, timing where the source imposes one, concurrency, and a required not_specified_by_source list. Three elements over the balancing state machine, and records the strategy-vtable structure the interface does not express. The status stays partially_mapped: the whole family remains a reconstruction of an existing implementation rather than the product of an architectural design activity, and Component Design remains absent.

providing_module.name: Balancing driver, BAL
providing_module.role: Decides whether and when to balance individual cells toward a target, and drives the AFE balancing commands. It is a state machine whose behaviour is supplied by a linked strategy: a voltage strategy, a history strategy and a do-nothing strategy each provide their own copy of the same three entry points.

consuming_modules.name: The balancing cyclic task
consuming_modules.consumption_evidence: The header states BAL_Trigger must be called time-triggered every 100 milliseconds at src/app/application/bal/bal.h L229; the cyclic task config is anchored at src/app/task/config/ftask_cfg.h L330-L338. The anchor FB2-SRC-COD-000019 records the shared BAL_TransferStateRequest at src/app/application/bal/bal.c L100-L180 and FB2-SRC-COD-000020 records the voltage strategy's BAL_ActivateBalancing at src/app/application/bal/voltage/bal_strategy_voltage.c L122-L153.

values.(no return value): The function returns nothing; its effect is on the AFE balancing commands and on the module-static state.

return_contract.default_on_no_information: A void periodic entry point gives the caller no way to learn whether the cycle ran or was skipped by its re-entrance or timer guards.
return_contract.evidence: src/app/application/bal/bal.h L231 declares void; the voltage strategy defines it at src/app/application/bal/voltage/bal_strategy_voltage.c L297. The history and none strategies define their own at src/app/application/bal/history/bal_strategy_history.c L345 and src/app/application/bal/none/bal_strategy_none.c L82.

validity_signalling.mechanism: No return value. Both the re-entrance guard and the timer guard return early without effect and without a signal.
validity_signalling.evidence: The re-entrance guard returns at src/app/application/bal/voltage/bal_strategy_voltage.c L301-L303 and the timer guard returns at L308; neither reports that it skipped the cycle.

timing.evidence: The header states the function must be called time-triggered every 100 milliseconds at src/app/application/bal/bal.h L229.

concurrency.evidence: Called from the 100 ms cyclic task. State changes inside the strategy are guarded by a task critical section around the state request at src/app/application/bal/voltage/bal_strategy_voltage.c L286-L292.
concurrency.protection_mechanism: re-entrance flag and a down-counting timer; a task critical section around the request write

error_paths.observed_behaviour: Returns immediately without advancing the state machine.

error_paths.condition: the state timer has not elapsed
error_paths.observed_behaviour: Decrements the timer and returns without handling the state machine this cycle.

not_specified_by_source: The interface does not state which strategy supplies this element, although bal.h declares it once and three separate source files define it; the caller cannot tell from the interface whether balancing is active at all in a given build.
The guards skip work silently, so a persistently re-entrant or timer-blocked cycle is invisible through this interface.
The header does not state what BAL_Trigger does in each state, only that it holds the sequence.

elements.consuming_module: Application code that requests a balancing state

parameters.name: stateRequest
parameters.meaning: Which state to move the balancing state machine to.
parameters.valid_range: A member of BAL_STATE_REQUEST_e. The source does not assert on it; legality is decided by BAL_CheckStateRequest, whose verdict is returned.
parameters.range_evidence: Checked by BAL_CheckStateRequest rather than by an assertion; src/app/application/bal/voltage/bal_strategy_voltage.c L287 delegates to it and the shared implementation is at src/app/application/bal/bal.c L112.

values.BAL_OK: The request was legal in the current state and has been recorded.
values.BAL_BUSY_OK / BAL_REQUEST_PENDING: Accepted but deferred; the state machine is busy or the request is queued for a later cycle.
values.BAL_ILLEGAL_REQUEST: The request is not permitted in the current state; it is discarded.
values.BAL_INIT_ERROR / BAL_ERROR / BAL_ALREADY: The module is not in a state from which the request can be honoured.

return_contract.default_on_no_information: Unlike STD_RETURN_TYPE_e this enumerator distinguishes legal, deferred, illegal and error outcomes, so the caller can tell a refusal from a deferral. The source does not state which of the remaining enumerators a given misuse produces.
return_contract.evidence: The enumerators are declared at src/app/application/bal/bal.h L115-L125; the value comes from BAL_CheckStateRequest at src/app/application/bal/bal.c L112, invoked at src/app/application/bal/voltage/bal_strategy_voltage.c L287 and returned at L294.

validity_signalling.mechanism: Return value BAL_RETURN_TYPE_e, which is a genuine multi-valued refusal channel.
validity_signalling.evidence: src/app/application/bal/voltage/bal_strategy_voltage.c L284 initialises BAL_OK, overwrites it with the check at L287 and returns it at L294; the request is only recorded when the check returned BAL_OK at L289-L291.

timing.evidence: Not periodic; applied to module state immediately and acted on by the 100 ms cycle on IFSE-001201.

concurrency.evidence: Called from a task. The request read-modify-write is inside a task critical section at src/app/application/bal/voltage/bal_strategy_voltage.c L286-L292, so a concurrent request cannot interleave with the check.
concurrency.protection_mechanism: OS_EnterTaskCritical / OS_ExitTaskCritical around the check and the write

error_paths.condition: the request is illegal in the current state
error_paths.observed_behaviour: Returns BAL_ILLEGAL_REQUEST and does not record the request.
Returns a deferred verdict and the request is not recorded for this cycle.
error_paths.evidence: The shared BAL_CheckStateRequest at src/app/application/bal/bal.c L112 produces the BAL_BUSY_OK and BAL_REQUEST_PENDING verdicts.

not_specified_by_source: As with BAL_Trigger, the interface does not name the strategy that implements it, so the set of verdicts a caller can actually receive is build-dependent.
The nine-value enumerator is not documented per value in the header, so a caller cannot know which enumeration a particular misuse yields.
The interface does not state whether a deferred request is guaranteed to be honoured later.

values.(state enumerators): The current state of the balancing state machine, one of the BAL_FSM_e values declared at src/app/application/bal/bal.h L71-L85.

return_contract.default_on_no_information: A state read has no failure value, so a caller cannot distinguish a module that is idle by design from one that is stuck in an error state without consulting the enumerator meanings.
return_contract.evidence: The value is read directly from the module-static state at src/app/application/bal/voltage/bal_strategy_voltage.c L349.

validity_signalling.mechanism: Return value only. There is no error channel, but the enumerator set includes error states, so the state read does convey a fault when one is present.
validity_signalling.evidence: src/app/application/bal/voltage/bal_strategy_voltage.c L348-L350 returns the state field; BAL_FSM_e at src/app/application/bal/bal.h L71-L85 includes error states.

timing.evidence: A read of module-static state; no period.

concurrency.evidence: A plain read of a module-static field with no lock; the source does not guard it, so a read concurrent with a state change is not serialised by this interface.

not_specified_by_source: The interface does not name the providing strategy, so a caller cannot know which state set is live.
The read is unguarded while the writes it observes are inside a task critical section (IFSE-001202), so the interface does not describe an atomic relationship between them.
The header does not state when the state is last updated relative to the 100 ms cycle.

interface_level_gaps.gap: The three entry points are declared once in bal.h and defined once per strategy file, so the interface a caller compiles against does not identify the implementation it will link.
interface_level_gaps.consequence: A caller cannot tell from the interface whether balancing is active, which strategy enforces it, or what behaviour to expect. In a build that links the none strategy the functions exist and do nothing.
interface_level_gaps.evidence: BAL_Trigger, BAL_SetStateRequest and BAL_GetState are declared at src/app/application/bal/bal.h L231, L216 and L241, and are defined three times over: voltage strategy at src/app/application/bal/voltage/bal_strategy_voltage.c L297, L283 and L348; history strategy at src/app/application/bal/history/bal_strategy_history.c L345, L331 and L393; none strategy at src/app/application/bal/none/bal_strategy_none.c L82 and L76.

interface_level_gaps.gap: BAL_Trigger skips cycles on re-entrance and on its timer without signalling that it did.
interface_level_gaps.consequence: A balancing state machine that is persistently deferred is indistinguishable at this interface from one that is running normally, so a stuck balancing cycle is not observable from outside.
interface_level_gaps.evidence: The two early returns are at src/app/application/bal/voltage/bal_strategy_voltage.c L301-L303 and L305-L309, and the function returns void.

revision_history.author: sw_engineer
revision_history.description: Three elements over the balancing boundary, read from bal.h and, for the strategy implementations, bal_strategy_voltage.c at 308028fb. The most important interface-level fact is that BAL_SetStateRequest, BAL_Trigger and BAL_GetState are declared once in bal.h but defined once per strategy file, so which behaviour a caller gets is a build-time choice the interface does not express.
